choose.when:
JOIN afv_script p ON p.id = r.script_id AND p.deleted = FALSE
JOIN afv_script_episode e ON e.id = r.episode_id AND e.script_id = p.id AND e.deleted = FALSE

JOIN afv_storyboard p ON p.id = r.storyboard_id AND p.deleted = FALSE
JOIN afv_storyboard_episode e ON e.id = r.episode_id AND e.storyboard_id = p.id AND e.deleted = FALSE
AND (r.storyboard_episode_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM afv_storyboard_episode e WHERE e.id = r.storyboard_episode_id AND e.storyboard_id = p.id AND e.deleted = FALSE )) AND (r.storyboard_scene_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM afv_storyboard_scene s JOIN afv_storyboard_episode e ON e.id = s.episode_id AND e.storyboard_id = p.id AND e.deleted = FALSE WHERE s.id = r.storyboard_scene_id AND s.storyboard_id = p.id AND s.deleted = FALSE AND (r.storyboard_episode_id IS NULL OR r.storyboard_episode_id = e.id) ))
JOIN afv_asset p ON p.id = r.asset_id AND p.deleted = FALSE

mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.version, r.deleted, AS project_id FROM r WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT r.* FROM r WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.version = #{version} AND r.deleted = FALSE
SELECT r.* FROM r WHERE r.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id FROM afv_storyboard WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = FALSE AND script_id = (SELECT id FROM afv_script WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id FROM r
LEFT JOIN afv_storyboard_episode ordering_ep ON ordering_ep.id = r.storyboard_episode_id LEFT JOIN afv_storyboard_scene ordering_scene ON ordering_scene.id = r.storyboard_scene_id
WHERE
r.storyboard_id r.episode_id r.storyboard_episode_id r.storyboard_scene_id
= #{parentId} AND r.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY
CASE WHEN ordering_ep.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ordering_ep.sort_order, ordering_ep.id, CASE WHEN ordering_scene.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ordering_scene.sort_order, ordering_scene.id,
e.sort_order, e.id,
r.sort_order, r.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r WHERE r.storyboard_id = #{storyboardId} AND r.deleted = FALSE
SELECT r.id, r.version, r.deleted, AS project_id FROM r WHERE = #{projectId} AND r.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY r.id FOR UPDATE
